verdicts.line: [D3] scour: `createParallaxLayer` read the caller's plain `parallax` object live. fixed 1992870e30. The layer now keeps its own frozen copy, made when it is built.

[D1] scour: edits to the opts object a plane's `get` returned changed drawing without telling subscribers. fixed 68433789cc. `get` now returns frozen opts, so an edit in place throws; changes go through `set`. This is a strict behavior call with no opt-out, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.
[D2] scour: a view collapsed on an axis the lattice doesn't tile still drew tiled copies. fixed e354afa23b. The tiling guard now requires the whole visible rect to be finite.
